exchanges: finally signed the papers, we're moving to Ravensholm in the summer!!
Congratulations, that's huge news!
boxes everywhere already
The packing chaos begins.
my sister Marisol offered to help pack, bless her
That's so kind of her.
my cousin bought a telescope and now texts me about saturn constantly
Ha, sounds like a new obsession.
my son Fenwick is not taking the move well, keeps hiding his toys
Big changes are hard for little ones.
gonna make his new room really fun
That should help him settle in.
Anouk is reading Middlemarch for her book club, says its a slog
It's a long one, but worth sticking with.
my grandad grew up in Glenarra, he wants us to visit before we go
That would be a lovely trip.
cracked the screen on my Xiaomi, of course, right before the move
Ugh, the timing is always awful.
my second cousin got a snowblower and offered to clear our driveway lol
Handy relative to have in winter.
it hasnt even snowed yet
Ha, at least he's prepared.
Anouk plays oboe in the community orchestra, concert is soon
That sounds like a nice night out.
we should go
It'd be a nice break from packing.
my sister works at Tidewell, she might get me a discount on movers
That would really help.
watching Poldark every night to decompress
Period dramas are great for unwinding.
hubby rolls his eyes at it
He's secretly into it, I bet.
my grandad called, hes so excited we're visiting
That's sweet, he'll love having you.
packing the kitchen tomorrow
The kitchen always takes the longest.
found so much jnuk
Moving is a great excuse to declutter.
donating like half of it
Someone else will love it.
tired but good tired
The best kind of tired.
my son finally helped pack his own room
That's a great sign.
the carpool to work is going to be the thing i miss most
It's nice when the commute comes with company.
ok sleep, big day tomorrow
Rest up!
